clips.title: The story
paras: Innkeeper Norman keeps the Trade Quarter tavern ready for travelers in the Undercity. The quiet, diligent Forsaken offers Horde travelers rest, hearthstone bindings, and food for the living and the dead.

Beneath Lordaeron's ruined capital, Innkeeper Norman tends the main tavern in the Undercity's Trade Quarter. Emissaries, mercenaries, and adventurers passing through the Forsaken stronghold find lodging there. Travelers come to bind their hearthstones, share news from across Azeroth, or prepare for journeys into the Plaguelands.

Innkeeper Norman sells provisions and manages rooms through most of the year. During Hallow's End, he joins the holiday revelry and asks adventurous patrons for peculiar displays, such as clucking like a chicken. Those who oblige can earn holiday treats like Undercity mints.
